__broaden__.δούρατα: δόρυ — spear (also beam, timber); neut. nom./acc. pl. δούρατα, epic stem δουρατ- (= Attic δόρατα): ’spears’ · also neut. nom. pl., of woodwork: ’timbers’ (δούρατα πύργων ’the timbers of the towers’)
__broaden__.θείη: θεῖος — divine, from the gods; fem. nom. sg., epic -η (= Attic -α) · also τίθημι — put, make; aor. opt. 3 sg. act., in a purpose clause with κε: ’he might make’
__broaden__.κάππεσον: πίπτω — fall; aor. 1 sg. κάππεσον, with κατά assimilated to the next consonant (= κατέπεσον): ’I fell down’ · also aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, subject plural: ’they fell down’
__broaden__.κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); with the subj. in purpose and general clauses · also + subj. in a temporal or conditional clause: ’whenever’, ’if’ · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’shall’ (κε μελήσεται ’will concern’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (τώ κε … ἠμύσειε ’then would collapse’) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (κε … ἔπασχον ’I would have suffered’) · also with an aor. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (κε σήκασθεν ’would have been penned’) · also + opt. in a condition after εἰ: ’if … might’ · also εἰς ὅ κε + aor. subj.: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … εὕρωμεν ’until we find’) · also ἤ κε … ἦ κε + subj., in an indirect alternative question: ’whether … or’ · also ὄφρά κε + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρά κε … θείη ’so that he might make’)
__broaden__.μήνι: μηνίω — be wrathful, nurse one’s wrath (+ dat.); pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (μήνι’ = μήνιε) · also impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (μήνι’ = μήνιε, Attic ἐμήνιε): ’kept up his wrath’
__broaden__.μεγάλην: μέγας — great, big; fem. acc. sg.: ’great (voice)’ · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ἠϊόνα: ’great (beach)’
__broaden__.πύργων: πύργος — tower, wall-tower; masc. gen. pl., after ἐπιβήσεαι (+ gen.) · also masc. gen. pl., after ἐπί: ’on the towers’ · also masc. gen. pl., dependent on ὅμαδος and δοῦπος: ’of towers being struck’ · also masc. gen. pl., dependent on δούρατα: ’of the towers’

__broaden__.τεῖχος: τεῖχος — wall; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’wall’

__broaden__.ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’)
